changes.oldText: Superadmins have a Dashboard entry in the administration sidebar, showing a board of system-wide cards: Session Status, Pending Sessions and Reasons, Agents, Agent Statistics, Failures by Entity Type, Audit Log, Total Resources in Resource Group, Sessions Created, and Folders by Usage Mode. More cards, such as Scheduling Failures, Resource Policies, Failed sign-ins, Container Registries, and Sessions by Status, can be added from the edit sidebar.
